data_description.entsoe_api_key: Security token from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform. Adds ENTSO-E's week-ahead load forecast to the model and is the price fallback when energy-charts.info has no prices. Stored in the config entry and never logged.
data_description.surcharge: Fixed amount in your currency per price unit, added to the price before VAT: total = (price + surcharge) × (1 + VAT). Applies to every price, Stromligning's included: its consumer price already contains the supplier's surcharge, so keep 0 there. Takes effect after the integration reloads.
data_description.hourly_average: Show the mean of each hour's four 15-minute prices, for contracts billed by the hour. Takes effect after the integration reloads.
data_description.attribute_format: Detailed: one entry per interval with start, end, price, unit and confidence (up to 72 hours). Compact: parallel arrays of start times (s, unix seconds), prices (t) and confidences in percent (c), about six times smaller, so up to 168 hours fit Home Assistant's 16 KB attribute limit. Takes effect after the integration reloads.
data_description.include_known_prices: Start the forecast attribute at the current slot with the confirmed spot prices (source: actual), then the predictions (source: predicted), as one continuous series. In the compact format, known_count gives the number of confirmed entries. Takes effect after the integration reloads.
data_description.cross_border: Two-stage model: learns the neighbouring bidding zones' prices from their weather and gives the forecasts to this zone's model (DK1: DE, NL, NO2, SE3, DK2; DK2: DK1, DE, SE4). Lowers the forecast error by about a sixth in the backtest, but trains two extra models per neighbour and stores their prices and weather: each training takes several times longer (tens of seconds on a Raspberry Pi 4). Takes effect after the integration reloads.
data_description.predbat_sensors: Add four sensors in the shape of Stromligning's rate entities for Predbat's apps.yaml: import today/tomorrow (the forecast with tariffs, surcharge and VAT, per kWh) and export today/tomorrow (the raw spot price excl. VAT). Today starts with the confirmed prices from midnight; tomorrow carries tomorrow and the following days as far as the attribute limit allows. Takes effect after the integration reloads.
data_description.predbat_tariff: Grid tariff in your currency per kWh excl. VAT, added to the Predbat import price only when no per-slot tariff is known (the day-ahead source has none; Stromligning's consumer price already contains it, so keep 0 there). Takes effect after the integration reloads.

get_forecast.name: Get forecast
get_forecast.description: Returns the whole price forecast (up to 7 days past the known prices) as response data, converted like the forecast sensor: unit, surcharge and VAT.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Open Spot Forecast entry (region) to read. Can be left out when only one is set up.

start.name: Start
start.description: Return the forecast from the interval containing this time. Default: now.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: Number of hours to return from the start. Default: the whole forecast.

hourly.name: Hourly
hourly.description: Average the four 15-minute prices of each hour. Default: the entry's hourly average option.

include_known.name: Include confirmed prices
include_known.description: Start with the confirmed spot prices (source: actual) up to known_until, then the predictions (source: predicted). Default: the entry's option.

evaluation.name: Evaluation
evaluation.description: Also return, for the last 7 days of slots, the prediction made about a day ahead next to the actual price (evaluation: start, end, predicted, actual, lead_hours).

reset_learning.name: Reset learning
reset_learning.description: Deletes an entry's learning database: the learned corrections, accuracy metrics, stored predictions and the price history the model trains on. The model retrains on the data collected afterwards.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Open Spot Forecast entry (region) to reset. Can be left out when only one is set up.
